findings.finding: The module preserves the exact selected Ambiq SDK 5.1.0 getter/setter bodies, their four-byte by-value ABI, capability bitmaps, and saved-PRIMASK key/config/lock sequence. This review does not establish whole-driver or firmware byte identity.
The emulator checks raw register memory and write ordering only. It does not model pad electrical behavior, enforcement of the lock key, mux routing, clocks, or board power sequencing.
The 224 entries are a logical register/API bound, not a physical pad inventory. Consumer wrappers are static evidence and are excluded from executed source-comparison coverage.

The unchanged upstream signed shift expression `1 << (pin % 32)` and C bitfield representation are validated only under the tested ARM target compiler profile; generic host portability is not claimed.
